statement: Data center revenue grew strongly, driven by demand for AI accelerators and server CPUs.
Gaming segment revenue declined as console demand softened compared with the prior year.
Gross margin improved due to a richer product mix weighted toward data center.
Supply constraints for advanced packaging could limit our ability to meet AI demand.
Revenue was a record, led by growth in the Data Center platform.
We expect next quarter revenue to be roughly flat sequentially.
Export controls may adversely affect our results in certain regions.
Demand for our products may not meet our expectations.
The client segment returned to year-over-year growth during the period.
Operating expenses increased as we invested in research and development.
Competition in accelerated computing is intense and continues to increase.
Gross margin benefited from a higher mix of data center sales.
We rely on third-party foundries, which exposes us to supply risk.
Management remains optimistic about long-term opportunities in artificial intelligence.
Inventory provisions increased during the quarter.
Results for the quarter were in line with prior guidance.
